title: Dellix/Quotes
summary:
"To be tested on a Casterwill Team on a mission, you must take it on yourself."
- Dellix to the Huntik Team, about the Casterwill law, (Chasing Void)

"You were too harsh."
- Delix to Lucas Casterwill about Sophie Casterwill, (Chasing Void)

"Our brothers and sisters are fighting down there! You can help, or go and talk"
- Dellix to Lucas Casterwill (The Spiral War)
